package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for exists_via_count_star: COUNT(*) used for an existence check instead of EXISTS or LIMIT 1.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.
type Rule261PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID int
	Name     string
}

func scenario261Positive(db *gorm.DB, tenantID int) (bool, error) {
	var count int64
	if err := db.Model(&Rule261PositiveRecord{}).Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Count(&count).Error; err != nil {
		return false, err
	}
	if count > 0 {
		return true, nil
	}
	return false, nil
}
